entries.09c160ba2308df1d: In the Ground Improvement Business, it is advancing the development and sophistication of proprietary methods and technologies, including automation and remote-operation technology for large ground improvement construction machinery, the automatic pile-driving system (GeoPilot-AutoPile), and the downsizing of the static compaction sand pile method (SAVE composer). In the Block Business, the company has technology related to wave-dissipating and foundation blocks, including Tetrapod, and in the current fiscal year it developed a Tetrapod grabbing machine.
